info.title: Pathly Study Companion API
info.description: CS252 Group 04 — courses and PDF ingest, accounts, scheduling workspace and AI companion. Register or log in, then use Authorize with the returned access_token.

429.description: Too many failed attempts; retry later

delete.description: Hard-delete current user and all related records with explicit confirmation.

get.description: Export complete personal data in JSON format (Issue #164, GDPR/Child Safety).

schema.title: Response List Courses Api V1 Courses Get
Response List Sources Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Sources Get

post.description:
PDF, DOCX, PPTX, JPEG/PNG photo or UTF-8 .txt up to 20 MB; the type comes from name
and content, not the client. Material is then mapped onto the roadmap in a job.

delete.description: Delete an uploaded file: its pages, their node links and the exercises quoted from it.

post.description: Extract concepts from uploaded pages (one file, or every file) and store them unconfirmed.

schema.title: Response List Items Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Concepts  Concept Id  Items Get

post.description: Extract existing numbered exercises; no model authors content (#115).

schema.title: Response Generate Concept Items Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Concepts  Concept Id  Items Generate Post

put.description: Updates ``syllabus_id`` from the body, else the latest syllabus (or creates one).
Spec 8.2's path; the course-scoped PUT above does the same for the latest one.

post.description: Nodes from the body, else derived from the syllabus (the given or latest one).

get.description: Discover persisted roadmaps without requiring a bookmarked roadmap ID.

schema.title: Response List Course Roadmaps Api V1 Courses  Course Id  Roadmaps Get

post.description:
One task per node, then sessions from the shared planner; nodes that do not fit
before their deadline come back in ``unscheduled`` and their weeks in
``overloaded_weeks``.

Propose or commit schedule changes for this roadmap (spec 8.4, 10.5).

Only pending sessions in the future are replanned; completed sessions and completed
tasks are never touched. Rate-limited to 1 proposal per day.

Enqueue background resource search for this roadmap node (spec 8.5).

Returns 202 with run_id. Rate limited to 20 searches per hour per user.

get.description:
Retrieve curated resources and coverage gaps for a roadmap node (spec 8.6).

Status is 'searching' if a search is in progress, 'ready' if at least 2 vetted
resources meet quality threshold (>= 0.65), or 'insufficient' otherwise.

post.description: Store feedback for a resource; if not helpful, replaces it from reserve (spec 8.7).

get.description: Only the user who started a job sees it; system jobs and others' jobs are 404.
The learner's own pages on this node: attached, then those awaiting one tap.

put.description: One tap: confirm a suggested page for this node, or reject it for good.

get.description: Retrieve full course roadmap graph (issue #103, spec 8, UC-03).
Retrieve local subgraph centered on a roadmap node (issue #97, #103).

post.description: Add a prerequisite edge; one that would close a cycle is a 409 with its path.

put.description: Save this user's node positions: a bare list (spec 8) or the older {positions}.

get.description: Retrieve review cards due for the current user (issue #162, UC-11).

schema.title: Response Get Due Reviews Api V1 Reviews Due Get

post.description: Submit a rating (1-4) for an item review card (issue #162, UC-11).

get.description: Retrieve recommendations for a roadmap node, recalculating if stale (>24h).

post.description: Log an interaction event for a recommendation (shown, opened, helpful, not_helpful, pinned).

get.description: Summarize recommendation metrics across all nodes of a roadmap.
Resources the job could not decide alone: unknown license, unsure labels, robots.
Only shared resource labels: never include private node/material text (#99).
Gaps per subject, resources per status, failing connectors and dead links (#105).
LLM and search spend per node, provider latency and daily quota use.

EdgeIn.title: EdgeIn
EdgeIn.description: ``parent``/``child`` as in spec 8; the older ``parent_id``/``child_id`` still parse.

RoadmapScheduleIn.title: RoadmapScheduleIn
RoadmapScheduleIn.description:
Sessions always fit availability minus busy blocks (spec 10.4); weekly and daily
budgets are enforced by the shared planner.
